title: Add RecipesFolderStore
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesFolderStore.swift as an @Observable class (or ObservableObject if @Observable causes issues on iOS 17). On init, reads bookmark Data from UserDefaults key 'recipesFolderBookmark', resolves it with withSecurityScope, and sets folderURL: URL?. If isStale is true after resolution, clears both UserDefaults keys and sets folderURL to nil. Exposes folderName: String? from UserDefaults key 'recipesFolderName'. Provides saveBookmark(for url: URL) to write bookmark Data and display name on successful picker selection.
acceptance_criteria: Reads and resolves bookmark from UserDefaults 'recipesFolderBookmark' on init
Exposes folderURL: URL? (nil when no bookmark or stale)
Stale bookmark is detected, both UserDefaults keys cleared, folderURL set to nil
saveBookmark(for:) creates security-scoped bookmark and persists Data + display name
No database or custom storage layer — UserDefaults.standard only
